title: User Command V1.0
description: Audio or Visual Scene Editing Commands: a request (UserCommandRQ), input to the AIM that executes it, or the response to it (UserCommandRS), output by that AIM under the same UserCommandID. Exactly one of the two is present, as in the other Data Types with a request and a response.

Confidence.description: How likely it is that the User Command is what the User asked for - for instance, when it is interpreted from what the User says.

UserCommandRQ.description: A request. Every amount in it is a number the request carries - where an Object is put or moved to, the loudness - and an AIM that finds none reports it, it does not guess one. Objects and Scenes are identified by the name the User gave them.

LUFS.description: The loudness, in LUFS, as a number. Alone it sets the loudness of the open Object; with ModifiedObjects it is the amount the modification carries when no entry has an Acoustic Profile or a Spatial Attitude.

RevokedUserCommandID.description: The User Command to revoke, by its UserCommandID (the author, 2026/10/11: every User Command has an ID, and one can revoke an earlier one). It goes to the AIM that executed that command, which undoes it if it can; the report says whether it did: Done, Failed, or NotSupported where the AIM cannot undo it.

ObjectID.description: The name of the Audio Object, or of the Scene, that the command makes of the Objects it adds (the name the User gives it, such as "concert"). Required when the command makes one: an Audio Object composed of the Objects, or the Scene created when none is open. A name that is taken becomes the name followed by the next free number ("concert 2").

SpatialAttitude.description: Where the Object is put: the position and the orientation, as numbers. Required.

OldSpatialAttitude.description: Where the Object is now, as numbers; names the Object when ObjectID is absent.

NewSpatialAttitude.description: Where the Object is to be: the position and the orientation, as numbers. Required.

ListedObjects.description: Asks the Editing AIM that keeps the Objects or Scenes of a Kind to list them: the response (UserCommandRS.ListedObjects) gives their names, never storage keys.

Kind.description: The Kind to list, or All for everything the AIM keeps. Required.

ClosedSpace.description: The space the open Scene is in - a room built round its Objects: a Closed Space, by ID or in full. It replaces the one the Scene had.

ModifiedScene.description: The acoustics of the open Scene: what happens to the sound of its Objects on the way to the listener. The Acoustic Profile given is the one the Scene has from now on.

TranslatedObjects.description: Speech Objects to translate into another language, with Text and Speech Translation (MMC-TST). The source language is the one the Speech Object's own Qualifier states. The translated Speech Object replaces the original in the Scene, at its place: there is no Object in two versions, nor two Objects at one place.

SpeechQualifier.description: The Qualifier of the translated Speech Object: its Attributes.Metadata.Language states the target language.

UserCommandRS.description: How the User Command was executed: output by the AIM that executed it.

Outcome.description: Done: every action done; Partly: some; Failed: none; Ignored: the command names nothing this AIM executes.

Action.description: The field of UserCommandRQ the action comes from.

ObjectID.description: The name of the Object or Scene acted on.

ResultID.description: The name of what the action produced: every edit is a new version, which has the name of the Object or Scene edited.

Reason.description: Why the action was not done.

ListedObjects.description: The answer to a ListedObjects request: what the AIM keeps of the Kind asked for, by name - never a storage key.

ObjectID.description: The name of the Object or Scene.

MemberObjectIDs.description: For an Audio Object, a Speech Object or a Scene: the names of the Objects it is made of.
